CustomField.complianceGroup: Integrity - Accurate;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Source - Salesforce
CustomField.formula: IF(OR( ISBLANK( Customer_First_Contacted__c ), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed')), NULL, IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Customer Update Pending'), TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Customer_First_Contacted__c) <= 7), IMAGE('/img/samples/flag_green.gif','Green Flag'), IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Customer_First_Contacted__c) <= 14, IMAGE('/img/msg_icons/warning16.png','Yellow Flag'), IMAGE('/img/msg_icons/error16.png', 'Red Flag') ) ) )
CustomField.label: Followup State
